Overview

Animizo Modifier is an easing modifier that lets you create animations inside Fusion without using a single keyframe.

The modifier outputs procedurally eased values you can drop onto any animatable parameter including position, size, opacity, rotation, and more. Choose from 37 built-in easing presets including Sine, Quad, Cubic, Quart, Quint, Expo, Circ, Back, Elastic, and Bounce in Ease In, Ease Out, and Ease In Out variants.

Use the custom curve mode with a visual curve browser and preset thumbnails for fully manual animation profiles. Bake procedural animations to editable keyframes when you need to hand off a comp or fine-tune manually.

Set up In and Out animations timed in frames. Generate a Modifiers Note to list every Animizo modifier in your comp with its host node and animated values.

It comes as two modifiers, one for number controls such as size, opacity and rotation and one for position controls such as Center. In Resolve both show as Animizo.

No keyframes, no Spline tool, no manual interpolation. Just pick a curve and set your start and end frames.

Key features

  • Create animations inside Fusion without using a single keyframe.
  • More than two points: Add Keyframe keeps the move going after End through up to six more points, each with its own frame, value and curve, and Smooth flows through them.
  • 37 easing presets including Sine, Quad, Cubic, Quart, Quint, Expo, Circ, Back, Elastic, and Bounce.
  • Ease In, Ease Out, and Ease In Out variants for every single curve.
  • Custom curve mode with a visual curve browser and preset thumbnails.
  • Bake procedural animations to editable keyframes for handoff or manual fine-tuning.
  • In and Out animation, timed in frames.
  • Generate a Modifiers Note to list all Animizo modifiers in your comp.
  • Works on number and position controls; in Resolve it shows as Animizo for both.
  • Drop the modifier onto any numeric or point control including position, size, opacity, rotation, and more.

Best for

  • Motion graphics and title animation
  • Logo reveal and brand animation
  • UI and HUD style overlays
  • Reusable animation rigs and templates
  • Procedural position and scale animation
  • Quick easing without touching the Spline tool

Setup & help guide for Animizo Modifier Install, find it in Resolve, the controls, common problems, uninstall

Animizo Modifier 1.3 Fuse package: the number modifier (Animizo.fuse) and the position modifier (Animizo Point.fuse). In Resolve both show as Animizo.

Install
  1. Extract the complete ZIP before installing. Keep its How to Install.txt beside the files.
  2. Resolve Studio / Fusion Studio: drag the supplied Lua Studio installer into the Fusion Nodes area, follow its prompts, then restart the application.
  3. Resolve Free: close Resolve and copy Animizo.fuse to your user Fuses folder. Create that folder if needed.
  4. Windows user Fuses folder: %AppData%\Blackmagic Design\DaVinci Resolve\Support\Fusion\Fuses
  5. macOS user Fuses folder: ~/Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/Fusion/Fuses/
  6. Restart Resolve. Use the instructions in your package if its installer or host version differs.
  7. For a manual install, also copy Animizo Point.fuse into the same Fuses folder.
Where it appears in Resolve

On the Fusion page, right-click an animatable number or position control → Modify With → Animizo. Select the Inspector’s Modifiers tab to adjust the animation.

Controls in plain words

Some controls appear only after choosing the relevant mode.

In animation (Number and Point)
Enable
Turns this modifier’s procedural animation on or off.
Animation Mode / Custom Curve
Chooses the easing shape; Custom Curve lets you supply an editable curve.
Start Frame / End Frame / Capture
Sets the animation interval. Each Capture button copies the current playhead frame to its adjacent field.
Start Value / End Value
Sets the beginning and ending number for the Number modifier.
Start Position / End Position
Sets the beginning and ending X/Y location for the position modifier.
Key 3 to Key 8: Frame / Capture, Value or Position, Curve
Keyframes after End (six at most), each with its own frame, value or position, and curve. Smooth flows through the keyframe, Same as In uses the In’s curve, or pick a preset.
Add Keyframe / Remove Last
Add Keyframe adds the next keyframe, holding the value before it: at the playhead when it is past the last keyframe, otherwise the In’s length after it. Remove Last takes the last keyframe off.
Strength
Adjusts the intensity of easing modes that expose this control.
Bounce Height / Bounce Damping
Changes bounce amount and how quickly the bounces settle.
Elastic Height / Elastic Damping / Elastic Frequency
Changes spring overshoot, how quickly it settles, and how often it oscillates.
Delay
Offsets the animation timing in frames.
Loop / Reverse
Repeats the motion or reverses its direction.
In Curve Browser / preset thumbnails / Apply
Opens curve choices and applies the selected preset.
Out animation and utilities
Enable (Out Animation)
Turns the exit animation on. Its timing and curve controls appear when enabled.
Mirror
Uses a mirrored return animation based on the In animation.
As Soon As In Animation Ends (with Mirror)
With Mirror on, starts the mirrored Out the moment the In animation finishes. Untick it to set Out Start Frame yourself.
Out Animation Mode / Out Custom Curve
Chooses the Out easing shape or its custom curve.
Out Start Frame / Out End Frame / Capture
Sets the Out interval; Capture takes the playhead frame.
Out End Value, or Out End Position
Where the Out animation ends. Without Mirror the Out starts where the In ended. On a new modifier it starts at the control’s own value.
Out Strength / Out Bounce Height / Out Bounce Damping
Tunes the Out easing and bounce intensity and settling.
Out Elastic Height / Out Elastic Damping / Out Elastic Frequency
Tunes the Out spring’s size, settling and oscillation rate.
Out Delay / Out Curve Browser / Apply
Offsets the Out timing or chooses and applies its curve preset.
Bake Animation
Converts the procedural result to editable keyframes in one undo step, then tells you what it baked. Save a copy of the composition first if you want to keep the procedural setup.
Generate Modifiers Note
Makes a sticky note named AnimizoNote1 listing every Animizo modifier with its host control and keyframes; clicking again updates that note.
YouTube / Clipyx Store
Open the Clipyx channel and the Clipyx store in your browser.
Common problems
Not in the tool search
Extract the ZIP, check that the file still ends in .fuse, and restart Resolve after copying it. Use the user Fuses location for a manual install. Avoid installing a second copy of the same tool.
An older interface still appears
Resolve caches Fuse code. Fully restart it, then try a newly added node; an existing node may retain saved values.
Modifier missing from Modify With
Animizo shows on number and position controls only. Both Fuse files (Animizo.fuse and Animizo Point.fuse) must be installed, and Resolve restarted afterwards.
No movement
Make Start and End values different, enable the modifier and scrub inside the interval.
An “Animizo” node, or “Unknown tool found: SizeAnim1”
That is an old test macro from earlier downloads, not part of Animizo. In Resolve Studio, run the Studio installer from a new download: it retires the old node. Otherwise close Resolve and move Animizo.setting and Animizo.png out of the folders listed in How to Install.txt.
Uninstall
  1. Close Resolve / Fusion. Move only Animizo.fuse out of the Fuses folder where you installed it, to a backup folder outside the Fusion search folders.
  2. If you used the Studio installer, its files are in the shared Clipyx/Fuses folder. Leave other Clipyx files in place.
  3. Restart the application. Existing projects using this tool will need it reinstalled to render the same result.
  4. Also move Animizo Point.fuse out of the Fuses folder. Keep the original ZIP for projects that depend on it.

Updates log

v1.3 Released 16 Nov 2026

Animizo Modifier v1.3 lets a move keep going after End through up to six more points, makes Bake clearer and fixes Bounce, Elastic and the Out.

What's new in 1.3

  • Keyframes after End: click Add Keyframe and the move keeps going through up to six more points (Key 3 to Key 8), each with its own frame (with Capture), value or position, and curve. Remove Last takes the last one off.
  • Smooth, the default curve for a keyframe, flows through it without stopping. Same as In or any preset makes that move its own, and Delay, Loop, Reverse and the Out (Mirror too) follow every keyframe.
  • Bake Animation is one undo step, and afterwards it tells you which controls it baked, over which frames, and what it couldn't bake.
  • Generate Modifiers Note lists the keyframes.
  • Both modifiers now show as Animizo in Resolve. Fusion offers each one only on its own kind of control.

Bug fixes

  • Bounce now lands on the End at every Bounce Damping setting, without a jump.
  • Elastic with low damping settles onto the End instead of snapping there on the last frame.
  • Out Delay now also delays a mirrored Out that starts as soon as the In ends.
  • With Reverse on, an Out of its own starts where the In ended instead of jumping.
  • Bake now bakes Ease Hold Ease and Custom Curve exactly as they play. Ease Hold Ease used to bake as Ease In Out.
  • On a new modifier, Out End Value (or Out End Position) starts at the control's own value instead of 0 or the centre of the frame.
  • Apply in the In Curve Browser no longer turns Loop and Reverse off.
